rejected: old hair H1, H5, H6, H7 (replaced by M1-M6)

old: darker skin tones never get blonde/very light hair (except the approved 'a' variants)
no two identical-looking characters in a shot
rules.detail_bar: No plain blocks: every asset needs 3+ readable sub-details at its normal shot size (trim/edges, a functional part, a surface/texture break, a story or life detail). Images, not flat colours. Cheap: bevelled boxes, shared materials, emission glows, no glass/volumes; measure render cost before/after (target <=5%).
